_comment_base_quality: min_base_quality and max_base_quality are omitted on purpose: absent means take the basecall-tier default (-Q1/--max-BQ 35 for sup, -Q5/--max-BQ 30 for hac), matching bcftools' ont and ont-sup profiles. Add both to pin them; they are a validated pair and should move together.
_comment_force_sup_profile: true applies the full ont-sup flag set regardless of the detected tier. This is not an indel-only switch: it also moves -Q and --max-BQ, so SNV calls and degeneracy codes shift with it.
